THE SPIRIT OF THE HOUSE

A little character.
A warm welcome.

At Palacete Rodrigues, a stay in Goa comes with the personality of a Portuguese heritage home: period furniture, a welcoming lounge and a garden pool.

Whether you are drawn to carved details or slower afternoons, find your rhythm here in Anjuna.

Necila Fernandes hosts the house. Share your dates, your group and what you have in mind, and begin planning together.
